title: Measured multi-SOH pseudo-OCV curves for Oxford Kokam SLPB533459H4 Cell1
cell: Kokam SLPB533459H4, 0.74 Ah pouch cell · Cell1
protocol: C/18.5 (40 mA) pseudo-OCV charge and discharge characterization every 100 Artemis drive cycles.
processing: SOH is the measured 1C discharge capacity relative to Cell1 cycle 0. At each measured checkpoint, SOC is normalized by that checkpoint pseudo-OCV capacity and pOCV is the pointwise mean of measured charge and discharge voltage. No SOH degradation equation is used.
